Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer navigated to the wrong IMDb title ID (tt0462590, the 2007 feature film) instead of the 1985 telefilm (tt0088853). This led it to report Auckland, New Zealand as the filming location, creating a false discrepancy with Wikipedia and potentially leading to the wrong answer.
